Offsets count the BOM; row, window and original hashes cover unchanged original bytes.

Odd bytes, unpaired high/low surrogates, missing BOM and wrong-endian BOM refuse, never replacing text.
Placement jobs and byte receipts keep UTF-8 output with original UTF-16 ranges and hashes.
